calls.statement:
WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.sale_date, cs.format, s.store_id
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT l.format, count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT store_id) AS stores,
       SUM(l.net_amount) AS sold_net,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) AS returned_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct,
       MAX(l.sale_date) + 30 <= (SELECT MAX(calendar_date) FROM dim_date) AS cohort_complete
FROM sold_lines l
LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
SELECT w.status, count(*) AS n_lines, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, count(r.sales_line_id) AS returned_lines, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2
GROUP BY 1

calls.statement:
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2 GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_receipt_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) WHERE r.refund_net > f.net_amount + 0.01) AS over_refunds,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) WHERE f.sales_line_id IS NULL) AS orphan_returns,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2 AND net_amount<0) AS neg_lines
